detail.text:
Summary for the operator:

The noon report nr-0006 from MV VALDA CREST (22 Jan 2025, 1200 UTC) has been extracted and checked — all required figures are present. The voyage_agent compared the Master's ETA for Rotterdam (26 Jan 0300 UTC) against the computed ETA of 25 Jan 2122 UTC based on the 1009.1 nm distance to go at 12.4 kn; the 5.6-hour difference exceeds the 2-hour tolerance, so the ETA is flagged as inconsistent. No charter party ETA notice is currently due. The performance_agent confirmed VLSFO consumption of 26 t matches the warranted 26 t/day exactly, so no consumption issue arises.

I have placed a yes-or-no question on your desk: whether to draft an e-mail to the Master asking them to confirm the ETA for Rotterdam. I will not send anything until you answer.
